briefdescription.para: Encapsulates an Aircraft and its systems.

detaileddescription.para: Owns all the parts (other classes) which make up this aircraft. This includes the Engines, Tanks, Propellers, Nozzles, Aerodynamic and Mass properties, landing gear, etc. These constituent parts may actually run as separate JSBSim models themselves, but the responsibility for initializing them and for retrieving their force and moment contributions falls to FGAircraft.
